scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,auth
scripts.test:emulators: npm run build && npx firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --project demo-booking-register --config ../firebase.json --only auth,firestore,functions "npx vitest run --reporter=verbose"
scripts.test:rules: npm run build && npx firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --project demo-booking-register --config ../firebase.json --only auth,firestore,functions "npx vitest run test/firestore.rules.test.ts --reporter=verbose"
scripts.test:functions: npm run build && npx firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --project demo-booking-register --config ../firebase.json --only auth,firestore,functions "npx vitest run test/functions.integration.test.ts --reporter=verbose"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions,firestore:rules
